exclusions.crossfile_webhook: Repeated live/offline use and tool-description tuning; excluded.
exclusions.greeting: Prior live requests and protocol repairs; excluded.
exclusions.legacy_repository_cohorts: Exposure not exhaustively audited; not imported or scored here. Old unanswered baseline is not evidence of advantage.

latency: Monotonic wall time around each isolated arm process, includes SDK/retriever startup; do not call it provider-only latency.

scoring.aggregation: Per-case paired differences and macro means over all six planned tasks; also completed-pair descriptive results. No significance or generalization claim.
scoring.automatic: Distinct exact file/entity precision, recall, F1 and reciprocal rank within submitted top 5; no substring match.
scoring.failure: Failed/no finish receives zero in all-planned completion-adjusted localization and answer scores. Not-run remains explicit with null raw score; separately report planned denominator and reached pairs.
scoring.manual: Four prewritten binary evidence criteria, one point each; freeze reviewer decisions and supporting answer/source excerpts before unblinding arm.
scoring.simulation: Scripted runs are never scored as model quality.

sending: Only shared system/controller prompts, question, tool schemas, prior model messages and allowlisted source evidence. Never rubric, gold, offline scripts, logs, other cases or credentials.
startup: Requires fresh user suite approval and live suite admission adapter with global stop behavior verified before paid execution; present CLI rejects live mode.
stop_policy: Sequential; any failed arm, unknown cost, timeout or changed binding halts entire suite; no automatic resume, retry, replacement or extra final response.
